title: ENTIA — 5.5M Verified Entities for AI Agents
description: 13 tools: entity lookup, BORME, EU VAT (VIES), GLEIF, healthcare & economic data. 10 countries.
summary: 13 tools: entity lookup, BORME, EU VAT (VIES), GLEIF, healthcare & economic data. 10 countries.
offersHint: 13 tools: entity lookup, BORME, EU VAT (VIES), GLEIF, healthcare & economic data. 10 countries. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://entia.systems/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: entity_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Look up any business entity by name, CIF/NIF, EU VAT, or LEI. Free callers receive a trace-level identity preview; authenticated callers receive the full paid dossier.

toolsPreview.name: search_entities
toolsPreview.description: Search verified entities across 10 countries by name, keyword, country, or sector. Anonymous callers receive a trace-level preview (name + city); authenticated TRACE+ keys unlock full records.

toolsPreview.name: verify_vat
toolsPreview.description: Real-time EU VAT validation via VIES (27 countries). Returns {valid, name, address, vat_number, country}.

toolsPreview.name: zone_profile
toolsPreview.description: Socioeconomic profile of a Spanish postal code — 17 blocks: income, employment, demographics, business census, real estate, FTTH, poverty, tourism.

toolsPreview.name: ai_ready_profile
toolsPreview.description: Full AI-ready JSON-LD profile for any entity — 4-node @graph (Organization, Place, LocalBusiness, PostalAddress). Designed for direct AI citation.

toolsPreview.name: get_competitors
toolsPreview.description: Find real competitors in the same sector and geography. Ranked entities with identity + location + sector matching.

toolsPreview.name: get_showcase
toolsPreview.description: Curated IBEX35 + EU entity examples. FREE — does not consume quota. Use to explore data depth.

toolsPreview.name: professional_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Verify professional registrations across 24 Spanish health/legal/psychology verticals. Returns colegiado number, college, specialty, status.

toolsPreview.name: get_full_dossier
toolsPreview.description: Aggregator — 90+ fields about an entity in one call. Combines 4 ENTIA sources in parallel: identity, zone, BORME, VIES. Killer tool for due diligence/KYB.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_stats
toolsPreview.description: Live platform stats: entities count, countries, sources, homes published.

toolsPreview.name: run_risk_audit
toolsPreview.description: Run comprehensive AI-readiness + digital risk audit on any domain. Analyzes SSL, DNS, structured data, LLM visibility. Returns risk score 0-100. 5 req/min, 30s timeout.

toolsPreview.name: get_entia_home
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the Schema.org JSON-LD @graph for a specific entity's Entia Home (machine layer at /v1/identity/{country}/{sector}/{city}/{slug}.jsonld). Requires country, sector, city, slug path segments — not cif/q. Obtain the path via entity_lookup / showcase (canonical_url). Fail-closed: never returns ENTIA corporate marketing as if it were the entity.

toolsPreview.name: get_entity_home_projection
toolsPreview.description: Read the materializer snapshot entia.entity_home_projection.v1 for an Entia Home (claims + projection + policy). Same truth as the public ficha HTML/JSON-LD twin. Serve from R2 sibling .projection.v1.json — no ad-hoc MCP enrichment.
